title: Cardinal Billing Account Installment Charges and Member Tenure: Relief Rate
content:
**Clause.** A relief rate multiplies the installment charge on a Cardinal Billing Account installment invoice: **0.50** when the most recent payment posted to the account was made by debit card, credit card or bank EFT and the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy's original inception date is at least 36 whole months before the invoice date; **0.75** when exactly one of those two holds; **1.00** when neither holds.

The most recent payment is the latest payment entry on the account's billing history by posting date. Tenure runs in whole months from the original inception date on the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy to the invoice date.

## Truth table

| Most recent payment by debit card, credit card or bank EFT | Inception at least 36 whole months before the invoice date | Relief rate |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 0.50 |
| Yes | No | 0.75 |
| No (check, money order or cashier's check) | Yes | 0.75 |
| No | No | 1.00 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, most recent payment by bank EFT)

| Whole months from inception to the invoice date | Relief rate |
|---|---|
| 36 | 0.50 |
| 35 | 0.75 |
